# AI Applications for Psychologists — Fall 2026

## Lecture 2: Large Language Models in Clinical Practice

This lecture introduces [[Large Language Models]] and their emerging role
in psychological assessment. We discuss prompt design and the risks of
Automation Bias in clinical decision support.

Objective 1: Students will identify at least two risks of using large
language models in a clinical workflow.

Objective 2: Students will critique a sample AI-assisted intake summary
for factual accuracy.

This week has no clear coverage for interpretability techniques, which is
intentionally left as an example of an uncovered objective below.

Objective 3: Students will explain saliency-map-based interpretability
methods for transformer architectures.
